items.textToSpeech: Beta-glucans contribute to the maintenance of normal blood cholesterol levels. The European Commission has authorised this claim for products which contain at least 1 gram of beta-glucans from oats, oat bran, barley, barley bran, or from mixtures of these sources per quantified portion. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 3 grams of beta-glucans from these sources.

Oat beta-glucans and barley beta-glucans have been shown to lower blood cholesterol. High cholesterol is a risk factor in the development of coronary heart disease. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 3 grams of oat or barley beta-glucans. The European Commission has authorised this claim for products which provide at least 1 gram of oat or barley beta-glucan per quantified portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
